steps.title: Prepare CSV transfer file
steps.instruction: Create a .csv file with a header line "source,dest,vol" and one row per transfer, e.g. "A1,B1,400". The source column specifies the well in the 15 mL Falcon tube rack (slot 5) and the dest column the well in the 2 mL tube rack (slot 6). Volumes may exceed the 300 µL pipette capacity but must not exceed 5000 µL per Falcon tube; add additional Falcon tubes and update the source entries if larger totals are needed.

steps.title: Load deck equipment
steps.instruction: Place the 15 mL Falcon tube rack in slot 5, the 2 mL generic tube rack in slot 6, and a tip rack so that well H1 is accessible. Arrange all equipment in the middle row of the deck as required for using the multi‑channel 300 µL pipette as a single‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Attach pipette
steps.instruction: Mount the 300 µL multi‑channel pipette on the robot and configure it to operate as a single‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Execute transfers for each CSV row
steps.instruction: For every row in the CSV file, perform the following actions:

substeps.instruction: Pick up a fresh tip from well H1 of the tip rack.
Aspirate the specified volume from the source well in the 15 mL Falcon tube rack (slot 5).
Dispense the volume into the destination well of the 2 mL tube rack (slot 6) that contains the dry primer pellet.
Drop the used tip into the waste bin.
